description: This file defines command-line interface commands for managing launchd agents, including install, uninstall, and status commands, utilizing Commander library for parsing and Foundation for file and property list handling.

classes.name: ServiceRootCommand
classes.description: Defines the main service command with subcommands for install, uninstall, and status.

classes.name: LaunchdHelper
classes.description: Provides helper functions for handling launchd plist files, such as writing and removing plist files.

classes.name: ServiceInstall
classes.description: Implements the install subcommand for setting up the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceUninstall
classes.description: Implements the uninstall subcommand for removing the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceStatus
classes.description: Implements the status subcommand for checking the launch agent's status.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes a launchd plist file with configuration for the agent.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executed for each subcommand to perform the specific operation.
